Review baseline: release/3.0 at fb5b59bda429b7545f82072dabe10f8b299432dc.
Classification: review-confirmed defect.

Source task: 01a09c57-2ac2-7981-8f33-21ede2d89ca2

1. **P1 — Callback failures can expose credentials.**  
   [callback.ex:48](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/callback.ex:48) stores exception messages and formatted stack traces in public error details. A handler that calls `Map.fetch!(credentials, :missing_key)` exposes the credential map through `Error.to_map/1`. A function-clause failure also exposes credentials through stack-trace arguments. Both cases were reproduced. [telemetry.ex:78](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/telemetry.ex:78) uses the same unsafe text conversion.  
   **Correction:** Keep the exception type and stack frames without argument values. Use a fixed public message. Key redaction cannot remove credentials after conversion to text.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Fixed in 93c94046 on release/3.0. Callback errors and exception telemetry use fixed public messages and stack frames without argument values. Exception type remains available. Baseline security regressions failed before fix; focused tests passed (18); root mix quality passed; demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and tests passed (21).
